prompt: Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Use Spectrum 1-4: page #F9F9FB, text #251F2D, accent #861D85, secondary surface #EFEAE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Libre Baskerville and reading text in Work Sans; traditional serif with flexible sans reading text. Composition: Large event title, date and venue, then an unframed program table and direct booking action. Use body 18px, heading 80px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 32px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
